discovery.auth: OAuth2 / API key per Kenar app

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Divar Open Platform (Kenar): official docs + SDKs (Python/Go/JS) in github.com/divar-ir; finder endpoints search_post/get_post (incl. car category), chat and add-ons; app registration required.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: API key of a Kenar app (https://kenar.divar.dev/management/api-keys); search needs the SEARCH_POST permission.

adapter.terms: Kenar Divar API limits (https://kenar.divar.dev/scopes/). The finder search may be called only 100 times in total per app, even in production.

search_listings.note: QUOTA: Divar allows this search only 100 times IN TOTAL per app (even published apps) — use sparingly. POST /v2/open-platform/finder/post {category: light (cars), city, query: {brand_model: [model], production_year {min,max}, usage {max}}}; no pagination (up to 100 newest posts). location is a Divar city slug (e.g. tehran); model is a Divar brand_model value (e.g. 'Pride 111 EX'); years are Solar Hijri (e.g. 1400–1403); mileage in km. price.value and vehicles_fields.usage are strings and stay in raw.

get_listing.note: GET /v1/open-platform/finder/post/{post token} with the API key only (no OAuth needed): category, city, district and data {title, description, price {mode, value}, images, brand_model, …}; absent fields mean zero/false. Prices in rials.

not_offered.decode_vin: No VIN lookup in the Kenar API.
not_offered.get_valuation: No valuation endpoint in the Kenar API.
not_offered.list_dealers: No dealer directory endpoint in the Kenar API.
not_offered.me: User endpoints need an OAuth grant from a Divar user; this adapter uses the app API key.

evidence: host open-api.divar.ir: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Asseco Data Systems S.A.)
probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 1/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages, 1 by their last segments; every parameter and body key named on the page
